tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, below the proposed onset at 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost option that directly tests whether the response continues to flatten or drops after crossing the threshold.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five gradients are below the proposed onset range, so the avalanche term is zero on every pilot row. Neither its threshold nor its strength can be fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb-Douglas law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Input and gradient rise together in the pilot, so the observed flattening does not distinguish smooth input inhibition from a gradient-driven threshold beyond the sampled range.
It costs more and does not directly target the unsampled high-gradient regime.
